meta.title: DCR — a build tool for C and C++, like Cargo
meta.description: DCR builds C and C++ projects and manages their libraries. It works like Cargo. You need one file, dcr.toml, and a few easy commands: new, build, run, test.

titleLines: A build tool for C and C++
hero.description: Build, run, and test your C and C++ projects with one file called dcr.toml. DCR also takes care of your libraries. You do not need Makefiles or CMake scripts. Just use dcr new, dcr build, and dcr run.

features.title: Features
lead: Everything you need to build C and C++.
One tool. One config file. One simple way to work.

items.title: Easy commands
items.description: Use `new`, `build`, `run`, `test`, `clean`, `add`, `fmt`, and `lint`. All of them are in one tool.

items.title: Libraries from many places
items.description: Add libraries from a folder, a Git repository, a registry, or your system with `pkg-config`. The file `dcr.lock` remembers exactly what you used, including the Git commit.

items.title: Build for other systems
items.description: Build your project for another operating system or CPU. Choose the target with a full target triple or a short name like `windows`.

items.title: Works with your editor
items.description: `dcr gen` creates `compile_commands.json` and settings for VS Code and CLion. You can keep using your editor.

items.title: One project file
items.description: The name, language, standard, compiler, and libraries are all in `dcr.toml`. Nothing is spread across many scripts.

items.title: Help is built in
items.description: Every command has `--help`. If you install with a package manager, you also get man pages, like `man dcr-build`.

quickStart.title: Quick Start
quickStart.lead: Create and run a C or C++ project in three steps.

steps.title: Create a project
steps.description: `dcr new` makes a project with a `dcr.toml` file and a `src/main.c` file that is ready to build.

steps.title: Set it up
steps.description: Describe your project in one short TOML file. You do not need to learn CMake.

steps.title: Build and run
steps.description: `dcr run` builds your project and its libraries. Then it runs the program.

cta.question: Do you need your own compiler flags, Qt, or a bare-metal build?

download.title: Download
download.note: The installer also installs dcrup. It helps you switch between DCR versions.
